definitions.explanation: A thin piece of material for tying.
A strip of material for fastening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紐|ひも}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{縛|しば}った→縛る：03925_shibaru⟧。
examples.english: I tied the package tightly with string.

examples.japanese: ⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紐|ひも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解|ほど}けた→解ける：18700_hodokeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{鞄|かばん}→鞄：00637_kaban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紐|ひも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}すぎる→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{短|みじか}く→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The strap on this bag is too long, so I want to shorten it.

notes:
{紐|ひも} means string, cord, strap, or lace - thin material used for tying.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {紐|ひも}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧: to tie with string
- {紐|ひも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|ほど}く→ほどく：10504_hodoku⟧: to untie
- {紐|ひも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧: to tighten a strap
- {紐|ひも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧: to loosen restrictions (figurative)
- ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紐|ひも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧: to tighten purse strings

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{靴紐|くつひも}→靴紐：16862_kutsuhimo⟧: shoelace
- ⟦{首紐|くびひも}→首紐：28271_kubihimo⟧: neck strap
- ⟦{腰紐|こしひも}→腰紐：28105_koshihimo⟧: sash cord (for kimono)

SLANG:
{紐|ひも} can refer to a man who lives off a woman financially (derogatory).
